project.description: Used to gather a report on available data.

hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/bin/bash export AWS_REGION=us-east-1
# Define SNS topic ARN from Terraform output SNS_TOPIC_ARN="arn:aws:sns:us-east-1:900561893673:s3-report-dev"
# Define report file REPORT_FILE="s3_scan_report.txt" nhlbi_account_number=714862078411 # Clear previous report echo "S3 Scan Report - Generated on $(date)" > $REPORT_FILE
# List objects in each bucket and append to report buckets=( 's3://nih-nhlbi-bdc-hfn-migen-phs000294-c1/' ) aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::${nhlbi_account_number}:role/nih-nhlbi-TopMed-EC2Access-S3 --role-session-name "get-phenotypic-data" > assume-role-output.txt export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=`grep AccessKeyId assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"` export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=`grep SecretAccessKey assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"` export AWS_SESSION_TOKEN=`grep SessionToken assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"`
for bucket in "${buckets[@]}"; do echo "Scanning bucket: $bucket..." >> $REPORT_FILE aws s3 ls "s3://$bucket/" --recursive >> $REPORT_FILE echo "" >> $REPORT_FILE done
aws s3 cp s3://nih-nhlbi-bdc-hfn-migen-phs000294-c1/ . --recursive
unset AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY AWS_SESSION_TOKEN # Send report to SNS
aws sns publish --region us-east-1 --topic-arn $SNS_TOPIC_ARN --subject "S3 Scan Report" --message file://$REPORT_FILE
